name: @faceless/templates
description: Drop-in video template plugins (manifest + Remotion component). Auto-discovered into a typed registry consumed by the renderer and the app's templates gallery. Designed to later ship as installable npm packages (phase-2 prompt §7).

scripts.build: npm run gen-manifests && npm run build-registry

comment:devDependencies: BUILD-TIME ONLY. zod authors each template's inputSchema (single source of truth); gen-manifests (tsx) exports it to manifest.json as JSON Schema for Python. zod is a TYPE-only import in components (z.infer), so it never enters the render bundle, and devDeps are not shipped — the npm-package trajectory is unaffected. .npmrc legacy-peer-deps keeps react/remotion OUT of this package's node_modules (single-copy dedupe in consumers).
